notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
When the Devoted Druid token enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate the nontoken Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Devoted Druid tokens, you may tap them to get infinite {G}.
